text:
The plate looks like a side or dinner plate of about 22-24 cm. On it are 3-4 green-wrapped dumplings (spinach wrappers), some sauce, and a serving of sautéed greens, possibly chard or bok choy.

The dumplings are large, perhaps 40-50 g each. Four of them come to about 180 g, at roughly 1.8 kcal/g, or about 320 kcal.

The greens are about 80 g with oil, which adds roughly 80 kcal.

Together that is about 260 g of food and about 400 kcal.
